description:
Title: OEE

Write a process, that collects relevant information from a machine, and calculated the Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE).
If the OEE falls below a certain value/percentage, stop the machine and send an email to an engineer.
When the machine is restarted, continue measuring.
When the machine is disconnected, stop the process.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OEE"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/oee">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineData" name="Machine information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StopMachine" name="Stop machine"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EngineerEmail" name="Email to engineer"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OEE">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OEE" name="OEE process" processRef="Process_OEE"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Machine" name="Machine"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Engineer" name="Engineer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineData" name="Machine information"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMachineData"
                      messageRef="Message_MachineData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StopMachine" name="Stop machine"
                      sourceRef="Task_StopMachine" targetRef="Participant_Machine"
                      messageRef="Message_StopMachine"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="Event_MachineRestarted"
                      messageRef="Message_MachineRestarted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineDisconnectedBeforeData" name="Machine disconnected"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="Event_DisconnectedBeforeData"
                      messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineDisconnectedAfterAlert" name="Machine disconnected"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="Event_DisconnectedAfterAlert"
                      messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EngineerEmail" name="Email to engineer"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendEmail" targetRef="Participant_Engineer"
                      messageRef="Message_EngineerEmail"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OEE" name="OEE" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OEE" name="Start measuring">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_To_WaitForData</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForDataOrDisconnect"
                            name="Wait for machine information or disconnection"
                            eventGatewayType="Exclusive" instantiate="false">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_To_WaitForData</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Continue_To_WaitForData</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WaitForData_To_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WaitForData_To_Disconnect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveMachineData" name="Receive machine information"
                      messageRef="Message_MachineData">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WaitForData_To_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_To_CollectSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CollectSplit" name="Collect required information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_To_CollectSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectSplit_To_CollectA</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectSplit_To_CollectB</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformationA" name="Collect relevant machine information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectSplit_To_CollectA</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectA_To_CollectJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformationB" name="Collect relevant machine information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectSplit_To_CollectB</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectB_To_CollectJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CollectJoin" name="Information collected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectA_To_CollectJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectB_To_CollectJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectJoin_To_Calculate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CalculateOEE" name="Calculate OEE">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectJoin_To_Calculate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Calculate_To_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckOEE" name="Is OEE below the threshold?"
                           default="Flow_OEE_NotBelow">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Calculate_To_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OEE_Below</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OEE_NotBelow</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_StopMachine" name="Stop machine" messageRef="Message_StopMachine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OEE_Below</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stop_To_Email</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendEmail" name="Send email to engineer"
                   messageRef="Message_EngineerEmail">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stop_To_Email</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Email_To_WaitForRestart</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForRestartOrDisconnect"
                            name="Wait for restart or disconnection"
                            eventGatewayType="Exclusive" instantiate="false">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Email_To_WaitForRestart</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WaitForRestart_To_Restarted</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WaitForRestart_To_Disconnect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WaitForRestart_To_Restarted</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Restarted_To_Continue</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_MachineRestarted"
                                  messageRef="Message_MachineRestarted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ContinueMeasuring" name="Continue measuring">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Restarted_To_Continue</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Continue_To_WaitForData</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DisconnectedBeforeData" name="Machine disconnected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WaitForData_To_Disconnect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DisconnectedBeforeData_To_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DisconnectedBeforeData"
                                  messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DisconnectedAfterAlert" name="Machine disconnected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WaitForRestart_To_Disconnect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DisconnectedAfterAlert_To_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DisconnectedAfterAlert"
                                  messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DisconnectedBeforeData" name="Process stopped">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DisconnectedBeforeData_To_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DisconnectedAfterAlert" name="Process stopped">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DisconnectedAfterAlert_To_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_WaitForData" sourceRef="StartEvent_OEE"
                       targetRef="Gateway_WaitForDataOrDisconnect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Continue_To_WaitForData" sourceRef="Task_ContinueMeasuring"
                       targetRef="Gateway_WaitForDataOrDisconnect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitForData_To_Receive" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForDataOrDisconnect"
                       targetRef="Task_ReceiveMachineData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitForData_To_Disconnect" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForDataOrDisconnect"
                       targetRef="Event_DisconnectedBeforeData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_To_CollectSplit" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveMachineData"
                       targetRef="Gateway_CollectSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectSplit_To_CollectA" sourceRef="Gateway_CollectSplit"
                       targetRef="Task_CollectInformationA"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectSplit_To_CollectB" sourceRef="Gateway_CollectSplit"
                       targetRef="Task_CollectInformationB"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectA_To_CollectJoin" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformationA"
                       targetRef="Gateway_CollectJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectB_To_CollectJoin" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformationB"
                       targetRef="Gateway_CollectJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectJoin_To_Calculate" sourceRef="Gateway_CollectJoin"
                       targetRef="Task_CalculateOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Calculate_To_Check" sourceRef="Task_CalculateOEE"
                       targetRef="Gateway_CheckOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEE_Below" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckOEE" targetRef="Task_StopMachine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">OEE < threshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEE_NotBelow" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckOEE"
                       targetRef="Gateway_WaitForDataOrDisconnect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stop_To_Email" sourceRef="Task_StopMachine"
                       targetRef="Task_SendEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_To_WaitForRestart" sourceRef="Task_SendEmail"
                       targetRef="Gateway_WaitForRestartOrDisconnect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitForRestart_To_Restarted"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForRestartOrDisconnect" targetRef="Event_MachineRestarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitForRestart_To_Disconnect"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForRestartOrDisconnect" targetRef="Event_DisconnectedAfterAlert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restarted_To_Continue" sourceRef="Event_MachineRestarted"
                       targetRef="Task_ContinueMeasuring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DisconnectedBeforeData_To_End"
                       sourceRef="Event_DisconnectedBeforeData" targetRef="EndEvent_DisconnectedBeforeData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DisconnectedAfterAlert_To_End"
                       sourceRef="Event_DisconnectedAfterAlert" targetRef="EndEvent_DisconnectedAfterAlert"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
